sections.content: To express quantities, Hungarian uses number words or quantity adjectives like 'sok' (much/many), 'kevés' (few/little), and 'egy' (one).

items.english: There are two pieces of apple.

sections.content: The word 'darab' (piece) is used as a measure word with countable items. 'Kevés' and 'sok' can come before or after the noun.
